# Original-script regression fixtures

These SVG files are raw black-box outputs generated by running the user-supplied Illustrator script:

`AI脚本插件146合集-146版.jsx` → `盒型2.0` → 独立盒型

They are test evidence only. Runtime code does not load or execute the proprietary JSX, Illustrator, or any website.

| Fixture | Model and parameters | Regression state | Target group | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `box-v2-lock-bottom-80x40x120.svg` | 锁底盒 L80 W40 H120 S0.5 T12 G11 mm | active | 2 | `22883bb3d70d46a311b8e944d068246430a8f23863e0a1f9274e1fa52b6b8619` |
| `box-v2-carry-handle-100x60x160.svg` | 手提盒 L100 W60 H160 S0.5 T12 G11 mm | active | 1, normalized from Y=297 mm | `bb74929700012796aca9ecb40deceb2638d04cd3fcd6e1d88cc5808502a41f8e` |
| `box-v2-lock-bottom-100x55x160.svg` | 锁底盒 L100 W55 H160 S0.7 T15 G14 mm | historical, not in active one-sample matrix | 3 | `b915da2bef3de5250404eae699ef2c1f868477dbfec96b3cbb271ae76ef59e8a` |

The files may contain earlier groups because the original ScriptUI action appended each result to the active Illustrator document. Active regression tests select the documented result, discard empty Illustrator paths, normalize artboard translation where needed, convert points to millimetres, and compare primitive kind, path command topology, sequence, and every coordinate. Per the project acceptance rule, each box model has one active original fixture.
